jobs.title: Mid-Market Sales Specialist
jobs.description:
About Payoneer
Founded in 2005, Payoneer is the global financial platform that removes friction from doing business across borders, with a mission to connect the world’s underserved businesses to a rising global economy. We’re a community with over 2,500 colleagues all over the world, working to serve customers, and partners in over 190 countries and territories.
By taking the complexity out of the financial workflows–including everything from global payments and compliance to multi-currency and workforce management, to providing working capital and business intelligence–we give businesses the tools they need to work efficiently worldwide and grow with confidence.
Mid-Market Sales Specialist
Role summary:
We’re looking for a highly motivated Mid-Market Sales Specialist within the GTM organization, supporting customers across the EMEA region. 
The ideal candidate is energetic, eager to learn, and ready to grow in a fast-paced environment. 
You will support our customers’ onboarding journey and growth, while helping identify revenue opportunities and deliver an excellent customer experience.
Israel
Hybrid
Full-time
What You’ll Do:
- Support onboarding for new SMB customers across domestic and global markets through telesales outreach, timely follow-ups, and low-touch engagement that helps drive activation and compliance completion.
1. Use CRM tools such as Salesforce, Salesloft, Aircall, and Marketo to support customer onboarding, assist with KYC completion, and engage prospects through structured call, email, and messaging outreach such as WhatsApp or Telegram.
2. Apply effective communication, active listening, and problem-solving skills to guide customers through the onboarding process and help improve conversion outcomes.
3. Manage communication with new accounts through calls, emails, and automated sequences while working closely with operations teams to support activation and approvals.
4. Help address onboarding, operational, and payment-related issues in a timely manner to support a smooth customer experience and encourage first funded transactions.
- Support onboarding and activation goals for the assigned portfolio by maintaining consistent outreach, encouraging progress to first funded transaction, and introducing customers to relevant Payoneer products where appropriate.
- Proactively share feedback, insights and ideas in team meetings to contribute towards new business growth
Who you are:
- Bachelor’s degree.
- 2-3 years of experience in B2B sales, telesales, inside sales, customer onboarding, customer service, or a related field; internships or early sales experience are an advantage.
- Strong sales acumen with the ability to work in an aggressive, target-driven environment, manage high activity volumes, prioritize effectively, and consistently deliver against deadlines and conversion goals.
- Good knowledge of Microsoft Office, including Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
- Fluency in English and Hebrew is a must, with excellent spoken communication, strong call handling ability, and the confidence to engage customers persuasively over the phone.
- Candidates with prior BPO, call center, telesales, or inside sales experience will be strongly preferred, especially those who have managed aggressive follow-up cadences and volume-based onboarding or activation targets.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with strong persuasive ability, organized reporting, and effective coordination across sales and operations stakeholders.
- Strong desire to learn industry best practices, contribute to the organization, and continuously improve onboarding, activation, and FFT performance outcomes.
#LI-MI1
The Payoneer Ways of Working 
Act as our customer’s partner on the inside 
Learning what they need and creating what will help them go further. 
Do it. Own it. 
Being fearlessly accountable in everything we do. 
Continuously improve 
Always striving for a higher standard than our last. 
Build each other up 
Helping each other grow, as professionals and people. 
If this sounds like a business, a community, and a mission you want to be part of, apply today.

jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Partner (Maternity Leave cover for 8 months)
jobs.description:

Riskified empowers businesses to unleash ecommerce growth by taking risk off the table. Many of the world’s biggest brands and publicly traded companies selling online rely on Riskified for guaranteed protection against chargebacks, to fight fraud and policy abuse at scale, and to improve customer retention. Developed and managed by the largest team of ecommerce risk analysts, data scientists and researchers, Riskified’s AI-powered fraud and risk intelligence platform analyzes the individual behind each interaction to provide real-time decisions and robust identity-based insights.
Riskified is proud to work with incredible companies in virtually all industries including Booking.com, Acer, Gucci, Lorna Jane, GoPro, and many more.
We thrive in a collaborative work setting, alongside great people, to build and enhance products that matter. Abundant opportunities to create and contribute provide us with a sense of purpose that extends beyond ourselves, leaving a lasting impact. These sentiments capture why we choose Riskified every day. 
About the Role
We are looking for a passionate and data-driven Recruiter to join our global team at Riskified. If you thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment and are excited by the opportunity to shape hiring processes that make a real impact - this role is for you. This position is a temporary role for 8 months.
As a Recruiter, you’ll take full ownership of the end-to-end recruitment process, working closely with hiring managers, HRBPs, and the employer branding team. You'll support hiring across a range of functions - from tech to business roles - ensuring a strategic, high-quality candidate experience throughout.

- Manage the end-to-end recruitment process, including job scoping, sourcing, screening, interviewing, and offer negotiation.
- Partner closely with hiring managers and HR Business Partners to understand hiring needs and develop effective recruitment strategies.
- Deliver an exceptional candidate experience through clear communication, transparency, and professionalism throughout the hiring process.
- Leverage AI-powered recruiting tools and automation to improve sourcing, candidate engagement, and overall recruitment processes.
- Build proactive talent pipelines using sourcing strategies, LinkedIn Recruiter, Referrals, and other recruitment channels.
- Use recruitment KPIs and analytics to monitor pipeline health, identify bottlenecks, and continuously improve hiring performance.
- Support employer branding initiatives and contribute to continuous improvement of recruitment processes.
Qualifications
- 2+ years of experience in end-to-end in-house recruitment
- Proven track record hiring across multiple functions: Tech, Go-to-Market, and Executive roles
- Global recruiting experience - managing hiring processes across different locations
- Strong analytical mindset - comfortable using data to guide strategy and decisions
- Exceptional relationship-building skills with both hiring managers and candidates
- Proactive, organized, and able to manage multiple hiring processes simultaneously in a dynamic environment
- Native or fluent Hebrew and English, with excellent communication skills (written and verbal)
Life at Riskified
We are a fast-growing and dynamic tech company with 750+ team members globally. We value collaboration and innovative thinking. We’re looking for bright, driven, and passionate people to grow with us.
Our Tel-Aviv team is currently working in a hybrid of remote and in-office work. We have recently moved to our new space in Tel Aviv - check it out here!

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager- SMB
jobs.description:
At Similarweb, we are revolutionizing the way businesses interact with the digital world by revealing to them everything that happens online.
Our unique data and solutions empower over 4,300 customers globally, including industry giants like Google, eBay, and Adidas, to make game-changing decisions that drive their digital strategies.
In 2021, we went public on the New York Stock Exchange, and we continue to reach new heights! Come work alongside Similarwebbers across the globe who are bright, curious, practical and good people.
We’re looking for a Customer Success Manager SMB to work closely with a selection of our SMB clients. The ideal candidate will have a background in digital marketing, data and customer success, and enjoy working directly with clients to help solve business problems and provide data-driven outcomes. This role will also serve as a product expert to help drive customer adoption and retention, generating insights and creative ideas for Similarweb solutions. This role will report to the Team Manager, Customer Success, TLV.
Why is this role so crucial at Similarweb?
The Customer Success Manager (CSM) is a vital member of the SMB Team, working closely with various internal teams and serving as a trusted advisor to our small and medium-sized business clients through a consultative approach.
The CSM's ability to build relationships with clients and help them derive significant business value from our solutions is essential for maintaining long-term client engagement with Similarweb.
So, what will you be doing all day?
Your role as part of the Customer Success Team means your daily responsibilities may include:
- Primary Point of Contact: Serve as the main contact for all users on the account, identifying client pain points and defining client success.
- Client Onboarding & Training: Manage the onboarding process, provide comprehensive training, and boost engagement with Similarweb's offerings.
- Trusted Advisor: Act as a reliable partner and advisor, offering guidance and support throughout the customer journey.
- Churn Risk Management & Retention: Identify and mitigate risks of account churn by implementing proactive measures to retain customers and enhance their experience.
- Client Engagement: Ensure clients are actively engaged with the platform, utilizing data-driven insights to highlight the value it brings to their business goals.
- Upsell Opportunities: Assist in uncovering and identifying upsell opportunities during the customer lifecycle.
- Product Expertise: Develop strong subject matter expertise across all Similarweb solutions.
Ideal Candidate Profile:
- Customer Success (or Account Management) Experience: Client-facing experience in a customer success role with strong planning and execution capabilities with strong Negotiation skills.
- Relationship Building: Excellent relationship-building skills with the ability to quickly establish rapport and trust with clients and internal teams.
- Analytical Skills: Analytical and consultative mindset, capable of quickly identifying solutions to problems.
- Presentation Skills: Strong presentation and storytelling abilities, particularly in analyzing data to share meaningful insights.
- Team Collaboration: Team player with the ability to collaborate effectively with colleagues and business partners, maintaining a strong customer focus.
- Proactive & Results-Oriented: Self-motivated, proactive, with an ownership mindset and results-driven approach.
- Experience: 2-3 years of experience in roles such as analyst, consulting, or digital marketing (SEO, PPC, media planning) – Advantage.
- Digital Marketing Knowledge: Solid understanding and experience in digital marketing - Advantage.
Join our team and help SMB clients achieve success by leveraging Similarweb's innovative solutions!
*All Similarweb offices work in a hybrid model, so you can enjoy the flexibility of working from home with the benefits of building face-to-face connections with fellow Similarwebbers.*
Why you'll love being a Similarwebber:
You'll actually love the product you work with: Our customers aren't our only raving fans. When we asked our employees why they chose to come work at Similarweb, 99% of them said "the product." Imagine how exciting your job is when you get to work with the most powerful digital intelligence platform in the world.
You'll find a home for your big ideas: We encourage an open dialogue and empower employees to bring their ideas to the table. You'll find the resources you need to take initiative and create meaningful change within the organization.
We offer competitive perks & benefits: We take your well-being seriously, and offer competitive compensation packages to all employees. We also put a strong emphasis on community, with regular team outings and happy hours.
You can grow your career in any direction you choose: Interested in becoming a VP or want to transition into a different department? Whether it's Career Week, personalized coaching, or our ongoing learning solutions, you'll find all the tools and opportunities you need to develop your career right here.
Diversity isn't just a buzzword: People want to work in a place where they can be themselves. We strive to create a workplace that is reflective of the communities we serve, where everyone is empowered to bring their full, authentic selves to work. jobs.title: HR Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.
So, what’s the role all about?
NiCE is seeking an HR Operations specialist to join our Global HR Operations team in Israel. 
This role will play a key role in driving process excellence, operational efficiency, and continuous improvement across Global HR Operations. The successful candidate will partner closely with HR Operations, HRIS, Talent Acquisition, Payroll, and Shared Services teams to identify process improvement opportunities, optimize workflows, strengthen operational governance, improve data quality, and leverage technology to enhance the employee experience and scale HR service delivery globally. 
In addition, this individual will support day-to-day employee lifecycle operations, ensuring timely and accurate execution of onboarding, employee changes, mobility, compensation updates, offboarding, and other core HR processes. 
The ideal candidate combines strong HR Operations expertise with a solution-oriented mindset, utilizing data, technology, AI and operational insights to simplify processes, eliminate inefficiencies, and drive sustainable improvements across the HR organization. 
How will you make an impact? 
Process Improvement & Operational Excellence 
- Analyze HR processes to identify inefficiencies, bottlenecks, service gaps, and recurring issues. 
- Drive continuous improvement initiatives across employee lifecycle processes. 
- Create and maintain SOPs, process documentation, governance controls, and operational playbooks. 
- Conduct root-cause analysis and recommend sustainable solutions to improve operational performance. 
Global Employee Lifecycle Management 
- Manage employee lifecycle transactions including onboarding, job changes, mobility, compensation changes, and offboarding. 
- Ensure timely and accurate processing of employee data and HR transactions. 
- Maintain employee records and documentation in compliance with company policies and regulatory requirements. 
HR Systems & Service Delivery 
- Partner with HRIS, Payroll, Talent Acquisition, and IT teams to optimize HR workflows and system processes. 
- Support enhancements within Oracle HCM, ServiceNow, and related HR technologies. 
- Monitor service delivery metrics and identify opportunities to improve SLA performance and employee experience. 
- Promote adoption of standardized processes and case management best practices. 
Data Governance & Analytics 
- Maintain high standards of HR data quality and integrity. 
- Perform audits and data validation activities to identify and resolve discrepancies. 
- Leverage reporting tools and operational metrics to generate insights and recommendations for HR leadership. 
Have you got what it takes? 
- 2-4 years of experience in HR Operations, HR Shared Services, HRIS, or related HR functions within a global enterprise organization. 
- Demonstrated experience driving process improvements and operational efficiencies. 
- Strong understanding of employee lifecycle processes, HR operations, and service delivery models. 
- Experience working with enterprise HR systems such as Oracle HCM, Workday, or SAP SuccessFactors. 
- Experience working with case management or ticketing platforms such as ServiceNow. 
- Strong analytical, problem-solving, and root-cause analysis skills. 
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. 
- Fluent English, written and verbal. 
Preferred Qualifications 
- Experience working in a complex global environment. 
- Experience with process mapping, workflow design, and continuous improvement methodologies. 
- Strong reporting and analytics capabilities using Power BI, Excel, or similar tools. 
- Experience supporting automation, system enhancements, or digital transformation initiatives. 
- Familiarity with HR operational governance, quality assurance, and service delivery metrics. 
What’s in it for you?
Join an ever-growing, market disrupting, global company where the teams – comprised of the best of the best – work in a fast-paced, collaborative, and creative environment! As the market leader, every day at NiCE is a chance to learn and grow, and there are endless internal career opportunities across multiple roles, disciplines, domains, and locations. If you are passionate, innovative, and excited to constantly raise the bar, you may just be our next NiCEr!
Enjoy NiCE-FLEX!
At NiCE, we work according to the NiCE-FLEX hybrid model, which enables maximum flexibility: 2 days working from the office and 3 days of remote work, each week. Naturally, office days focus on face-to-face meetings, where teamwork and collaborative thinking generate innovation, new ideas, and a vibrant, interactive atmosphere.

jobs.title: LTD Controller
jobs.description:
Yotpo is leading the next era of trust and loyalty in eCommerce. With AI-powered Reviews and Loyalty solutions, we help brands turn browsers into customers and customers into advocates. Through deep integrations across the eCommerce ecosystem and the trust of over 30,000 global brands, Yotpo delivers seamless omnichannel experiences that increase conversion, strengthen customer relationships, and drive profitable, long-term growth.

- CPA (Israeli license) with a Big 4 background – Must.
- Experience: 2+ years as a Controller / Assistant Controller in Hi-Tech/SaaS, or 4+ years at a CPA firm.
- Professional Knowledge: Israeli tax, Israeli GAAP and US GAAP – Must.
- Language: Fluent Hebrew and English – Must.
- Systems: Advanced Excel; NetSuite, Zip, Mesh, Stripe and Shopify – significant advantage.

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Come join the organization that is redefining security for the AI era. As one of the fastest-growing startups ever, we enable teams to secure cloud and AI applications by connecting code, cloud, and runtime into a single shared context. Trusted by security teams all over the world, we have a proven track record of success and a culture that values world-class talent. Not to mention, we're now powered by Google, meaning we offer our customers an AI-powered platform that harnesses Google’s Threat Intelligence and Security Operations to better detect, prevent, and respond to threats across all environments, allowing for further innovation.
Our Wizards from all over the globe work together to protect the infrastructure of our customers, including over 65% of the Fortune 100, who trust us to scan and secure over 230 billion files daily. We’re honored to be a leading player in a massive and growing market, and we continue to look for exceptional Wizards who are eager to make a significant impact on our team. At Wiz, you’ll have the freedom to think creatively, dream big, and use your full range of skills to contribute to our momentous growth. Come join our team and help us create secure cloud environments that allow even the best companies to move faster, all while having some fun!
Minimum qualifications
- Degree in Computer Science, equivalent technical background, or hands-on technical experience.
- Experience in product marketing, solutions engineering, or product management at an enterprise-focused software or SaaS company.
- Excellent written and verbal communication, presentation, and core messaging skills in English.
- Proven track record of driving product adoption, GTM strategy, and marketing for technical audiences with the ability to effectively engage security, cloud, and developer personas within enterprises.
Preferred qualifications
- Prior experience working with major cloud providers such as AWS, Azure, and GCP.
- Experience in the cybersecurity industry.
- Proven track record of leading end-to-end product and feature launches.
- Demonstrated experience working closely with cross-functional sales and product teams.
- Proven ability to think strategically, problem-solve, and execute independently.
- Strong project management skills to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment, with a willingness to roll up your sleeves and get scrappy in a startup environment.
About the job
In this role, we are looking for a Go To Market (GTM) to own business growth and product strategy to support the rapid growth of Wiz. This includes owning the product go to market strategy for one of our product areas, creating compelling messaging and positioning, launching new features, enabling the field teams, and partnering with marketing and revenue to target the right buyers and influencers.
Responsibilities
- Act as a business owner for your product area to measure and accelerate commercial success and product growth by owning launch execution, pipeline impact, and market expansion.
- Define use cases, product messaging and positioning, value propositions, and customer profiles to showcase the value of Wiz.
- Become a subject matter expert in cloud security with an in-depth understanding of the market and products, including overall value proposition, features, functionality, and the verticals and use cases in which they are relevant.
- Partner closely with product management to ensure we are delivering on end to end scenarios that meet customer needs and to execute world class product and feature launches.
- Develop tools and training to support the full sales cycle, including product demos, sales training, reference architectures, and competitive intelligence to the field and marketing organizations.
- Define the strategic narrative for GTM and deliver key messages that enable our marketing team to execute high-quality digital and event-based campaigns and programs.
- Work closely with our demand generation teams to drive the pipeline for the sales organization.

jobs.title: Web Operations Manager - Contractor Position
jobs.description:
Cato Networks is the converged network and security cloud for the AI era. 
As AI reshapes cybersecurity, enterprises face a dual challenge: unlocking AI’s potential while defending against AI-driven attacks. Cato addresses both through a unified, cloud-native platform, providing the visibility and context to prioritize risks and stop threats in real time across users, applications, data, and AI agents. 
Join us as we scale: take on ambitious technological challenges and shape the next generation of enterprise security at a company trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide. 
Cato Networks is looking for a Web Operations Manager as a contractor to keep our web projects organized, our resources focused, and our website up to date. In this contract role, you’ll manage incoming web requests, coordinate work across internal teams and external partners, and perform website updates yourself. 
This role combines strong project management with hands-on execution. You’ll turn requests into clear assignments, balance priorities and capacity, and ensure work moves from intake to launch with consistent quality. 
What you’ll do 
- Manage web ticket requests. Own the request queue, clarify requirements, assess urgency, and establish priorities, owners, and delivery timelines. 
- Coordinate resources and workloads. Allocate work across developers, designers, content contributors, and agency partners based on skills, availability, and business priorities. Identify capacity constraints and resolve scheduling conflicts. 
- Drive projects through completion. Manage briefs, schedules, dependencies, reviews, and approvals. Proactively address blockers and keep stakeholders informed. 
- Perform website updates. Publish and maintain pages, content, images, navigation, forms, and other website elements through our content management system. 
- Support campaigns and launches. Coordinate web deliverables, confirm readiness, and ensure updates go live accurately and on schedule. 
- Maintain quality. Check content, links, layouts, forms, and functionality across devices and browsers before and after publishing. 
- Improve web operations. Establish practical intake processes, ticket standards, documentation, and reporting that make work easier to request, execute, and track. 
- Track delivery performance. Monitor backlog, turnaround times, workload, and recurring issues to improve planning and execution. 
What you’ll bring 
- Experience in web operations, digital project management, or website management. 
- Strong project management skills, with a track record of managing multiple priorities and delivering work on schedule. 
- Experience managing ticket queues and coordinating resources across internal teams, contractors, or agencies. 
- Hands-on proficiency with content management systems and confidence making website updates independently. 
- The ability to translate stakeholder requests into clear, actionable requirements and acceptance criteria. 
- Strong attention to detail and a disciplined approach to QA and follow-through. 
- Clear communication, sound judgment, and confidence negotiating priorities and setting expectations. 
- Strong English communication skills for supporting a global marketing website. 
Familiarity with HTML/CSS, web analytics, SEO fundamentals, and marketing automation is a plus. 
What makes this opportunity different 
We’re building an AI-forward marketing organization, and this role offers a hands-on opportunity to be part of that work. 
- Learn and apply AI tools. If you haven’t tried AI-assisted development, often called “vibe coding,” you’ll have the opportunity to learn it alongside other AI tools that support web marketing, experimentation, and execution. 
- Help build the foundation for AI-driven experiences. Participate in major web infrastructure upgrades that will enable new ways to engage visitors and support their journeys. 
- Bring your experience and expand your impact. If you already use AI tools or have built AI-enabled web experiences, you’ll have opportunities to take on broader ownership and more advanced initiatives. 
You don’t need to arrive as an AI expert. Curiosity, initiative, and a willingness to learn are essential. We’re looking for someone who can deliver strong web marketing today while helping us build what comes next.

jobs.title: Decision Analyst
jobs.description:
About the role:
As a Decision Analyst at Forter, you will own one of the company’s most critical assets: the accuracy, robustness, and performance of what is widely recognized as the leading e-commerce fraud decisioning system in the industry.
You will be expected to think creatively and push boundaries, constantly improving how we identify fraud and protect legitimate customers. You will design logical and technical solutions to real, constantly evolving challenges faced by some of the world’s largest online retailers. Your work will operate at the intersection of deep data research, real-time production decisioning systems, and real-world impact.
This position has strong technical and analytical depth, but you don’t need prior coding experience. With agentic tools like Claude Code and our structured training, candidates that are a strong fit can close any technical gaps quickly. We hire across multiple levels and adjust the scope and level of ownership based on what we learn during the interview process.
You will join Forter’s Decision Science and Analytics department, a high-bar, fast-moving group with a strong culture of excellence, curiosity, and ownership. We work in an informal, collaborative environment where strong opinions are welcome and great ideas move fast. The role offers meaningful growth opportunities, with clear paths toward both senior individual contributor and managerial roles, allowing you to shape your career based on your strengths.
Your work will directly shape Forter’s product, protect hundreds of millions of consumers, and help define the future of trust in digital commerce.
What you'll be doing:
- Invent, design, implement, and continuously refine the core decisioning logic and models that run in Forter’s live production systems
- Research complex fraud patterns, adversarial behaviors, and emerging threats
- Leverage rich and diverse datasets to generate actionable insights, build new system components, and advance feature engineering efforts
- Use agentic tools such as Claude Code to develop automatic tools and processes that improve the accuracy, scalability, and efficiency of our systems
- Collaborate closely with Engineers, Product Managers, and business stakeholders to build the next generation of Forter’s AI-driven technology
What you'll need:
- Psychometric score above 700 or equivalent (e.g. GMAT) - we use this as a baseline measure of structured reasoning and analytical speed
- A record of high achievement, in whatever form that's taken in your life - academic, professional, military, or otherwise
- Strong analytical and logical reasoning skills, with a proven ability to break down and solve highly complex problems
- Strong technical orientation. Experience with Python, SQL, or R is an advantage but not required. You should be comfortable learning new tools and technologies
- Excellent communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain complex technical ideas and research outcomes to a wide range of audiences
- Natural curiosity and the ability to understand systemic behaviors and adversarial tactics
- Proactive and results-driven mindset, with the ability to work independently within a collaborative team
- Experience building things with AI: agentic workflows, apps, automations. Bring an example you built and can walk us through. You should be enthusiastic about and comfortable with agentic tools.
Bonus points for:
- Experience with SQL or Python
- Familiarity with machine learning concepts
- Background in risk analysis, intelligence, or adversarial research
About us:
Commerce is evolving faster than the systems built to support it. Agentic AI is redrawing how people buy. Customer expectations have a new ceiling. And bad actors are evolving alongside every advancement. 
Forter was built to meet this moment — and stay ahead of it.
We are a human-first, AI-built company. Our technology analyzes patterns across a network of over 2 billion shoppers, delivering identity intelligence across the entire commerce journey — from sign-up to checkout to returns — that protects revenue and unlocks great customer experiences simultaneously. With Forter, businesses know who to trust, whether it’s humans or the agents shopping for them. The result: zero friction for the customers who matter. No revenue left behind.
The world's most trusted brands — Nordstrom, Instacart, Priceline, Adobe, ASOS, and eBay among them — rely on Forter to get this right. Since 2013, we've raised $525M from investors including Tiger Global, Bessemer, Sequoia Capital, and Salesforce Ventures, and today we power commerce decisions for nearly 1 million businesses globally. We're more than fraud, payments and orchestration – we make trust a competitive advantage.
Trust is backed by data – Forter is a recipient of over 10 workplace and innovation awards, including: 
- Great Place to Work Certification (2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025)
- Fortune’s Best Workplaces in NYC (2022, 2023, 2024 and 2025)
- Forbes Cloud 100 (2021, 2022, 2023, 2024 and 2025)
- Anti-Fraud Solution of the Year at the Payments Awards (2024)
Life as a Forterian:
Forterians are, genuinely, some of the best people you'll work with. Smart, curious, and deeply good humans who care about the work and each other. That's not an accident — it's something we've been intentional about since day one, and it's the thing people mention most when they talk about why they stay. When you're surrounded by people like this, doing work that actually matters, it changes what a job can feel like.
Forter was built on a simple but powerful conviction: when AI does its job, humans can do theirs better. That philosophy shapes our products and shapes how we work. AI is core to our workflows — not as a shortcut, but as a force multiplier that gives Forterians the space to focus their energy where human judgment is irreplaceable.
We're a global team of 500+ people, with regional headquarters in New York, Tel Aviv, London, and Singapore, and employee presence across the US, Canada, Germany, France, Japan, China, and Australia. Our teams are cross-functional by design, and the work you do here is visible, consequential, and connected to the outcomes that matter.
You'll have real ownership here and proximity to decisions. And we back that with investment in your growth — RSU offerings, L&D programs built around AI tools, and a culture of recognition rooted in our 4.5 day weeks (aka Forter’s Appreciation Fridays and Sundays). From team outings to local cultural celebrations, we mark the moments that matter — wherever you are in the world. We don't want Forter to be just another job. We want it to be the place you build.
If you're ready to work on a problem that sits at the intersection of AI, commerce, and human trust, this is it.
Forter is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer that will consider all qualified applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, marital status, gender identity or expression, national origin, genetics, age, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please email us at interviewaccommodation@forter.com. This information will be treated as confidential and used only for the purpose of determining an appropriate accommodation for the interview process.
Hybrid work:
At Forter, we embrace a hybrid work model that blends in-person connection with the flexibility of remote work. Team members based near our key hubs are expected to work from the office at least three days per week. We believe that regular face-to-face collaboration fuels professional development, strengthens our culture, and builds the relationships that help teams thrive.

jobs.title: NetSuite Administrator
jobs.description:
Description
This is us 
Kaltura (NYSE: KLTR) is a global software company on a mission to transform digital experiences from one-way interactions into intelligent, personalized conversations that move people forward.
Founded in 2006, we started by making video more accessible to organizations around the world. Today, we're taking that foundation much further, combining conversational AI, rich media, enterprise knowledge, and data to build a new generation of intelligent digital experiences.
Our technology helps organizations turn their content and knowledge into interactive, AI-powered experiences that can guide customers, train employees, support learners, and engage audiences in real time. From AI agents and personalized learning experiences to digital events, content hubs, and media platforms, we're changing how people interact with technology, and what technology can do for them.
More than 1,000 organizations worldwide rely on Kaltura, reaching over 100 million users at home, at work, and at school.
And the people behind it? We're a global team of 600+ employees, with offices in New York, London, Singapore, and Tel Aviv, united by a culture of openness, flexibility, and collaboration. Kaltura is a fast-paced environment where ideas are welcome, initiative is encouraged, and there's always something new to build, challenge, or improve. We believe in giving people the freedom to make an impact, the flexibility to balance work and life, and the opportunity to grow as we continue to evolve.
If you don't meet 100% of the requirements below, that's okay. Nobody's perfect! We believe in hiring people, not just a list of skills. If this sounds like a place where you'd be excited to learn, contribute, and make an impact, we'd love to hear from you.
Requirements
The role 
We are seeking an experienced NetSuite Administrator to join our Finance Systems team. In this role, you will be responsible for supporting, optimizing, and scaling our NetSuite ERP environment while partnering closely with Corporate Accounting and cross-functional stakeholders. You will play a key role in NetSuite implementation and expansion initiatives, finance process automation, systems integration, and continuous improvement efforts across our Finance technology ecosystem.
This is an exciting opportunity for a hands-on professional who combines strong NetSuite expertise with a solid understanding of accounting and finance processes, helping drive operational efficiency, scalability, and business growth.
The day-to-day
- Administer, maintain, and optimize the NetSuite platform, ensuring system stability, performance, security, and scalability.
- Partner with Corporate Accounting, Finance, and business stakeholders to improve processes, strengthen controls, and maximize system utilization.
- Configure and maintain NetSuite workflows, saved searches, reports, dashboards, roles, and permissions to support evolving business needs.
- Support NetSuite implementation and enhancement initiatives, including data migration, data conversion, testing, deployment, and post-go-live optimization.
- Support and maintain integrations across the Finance technology ecosystem, with a particular focus on Salesforce (SFDC) and other critical business applications.
- Drive automation and continuous improvement initiatives to streamline month-end close, financial reporting, and operational finance processes.
- Troubleshoot system issues, support end users, maintain documentation, and collaborate with global teams across multiple regions and time zones.
﻿Ideally, we’re looking for:
- Hands-on experience administering NetSuite, including configuration, workflows, saved searches, reporting, dashboards, roles, and permissions.
- Strong understanding of Accounting and Finance processes, including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Revenue Recognition, and Month-End Close.
- Experience supporting ERP implementations, system enhancements, integrations, and data migration or conversion initiatives.
- Experience supporting Salesforce (SFDC) integrations and related quote-to-cash or finance business processes.
- Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively across global cross-functional teams.
These would also be nice: 
- CPA certification and/or a degree in Accounting, Finance, Information Systems, or a related field.
- Experience working in a SOX-compliant environment and supporting publicly traded or SaaS companies.
- Experience with SuiteFlow, SuiteAnalytics, AI-enabled tools, FP&A platforms, budgeting, forecasting, planning, or other Finance technology applications.
The perks:
- Hybrid, flexible work environment 
- Extended private health (including mental) insurance 
- Personal and professional development programs 
- Occasional Cross company long weekends

jobs.title: EFA Specialist
jobs.description:
Description
Deloitte is looking for an Engagement Financial Advisor (EFA) to support the financial management of client engagements from inception to completion.
The role combines financial analysis, project controlling, forecasting, billing and collection (client-facing), and business partnering with engagement leaders to drive profitability and financial performance.

- Manage project budgeting, pricing, forecasting, and financial performance.
- Monitor revenue, profitability, utilization, and DSO metrics (plan vs. actual).
- Prepare and analyze financial reports to identify red flags and delivery insights for Partners and engagement leaders.

- Manage billing processes, collections, and financial reconciliations including interface with external clients and their payment systems.
- Ongoing interface with project leaders and finance teams.

- Bachelor's degree in Economics, Business Administration, Accounting, or related field.
- Experience in finance, controlling, budgeting, or financial analysis.
- Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.
- Advanced Excel proficiency; SAP experience is an advantage.
- Experience working with senior stakeholders in at least a medium-size organization.
- Ability to work independently and manage priorities
- Experience and/or ability to work with AI tools – mandatory
- Fluent Hebrew and strong English skills.
**We at Deloitte believe that diversity and inclusion among our people is a critical component of our success and therefore we foster a corporate culture that embraces diversity in all its forms.

jobs.title: Finance Transformation Consultant

You will work directly with client finance teams to challenge existing ways of working, design better processes, and implement solutions. jobs.title: Finance Transformation Manager
jobs.description:
Description
Deloitte is looking for a Manager with hands-on experience in the finance function of a global high-tech company—particularly in software, SaaS, cybersecurity, or digital platforms—to join our Finance Transformation practice and lead the development and delivery of our services to technology companies.
In this role, you will work with senior finance leaders, including CFOs, to redesign finance processes and embed AI as part of broader programs transforming how finance functions operate, while being part of Deloitte’s global Finance Transformation practice.
What you'll do
- Help shape and grow Deloitte’s Finance Transformation offering for the technology sector, bringing your industry experience to a broad range of clients.
- Work with CFOs, controllers, and other senior finance leaders to rethink how their finance functions operate.
- Lead transformation projects spanning finance operating models, processes, reporting, controls, and technology.
- Turn opportunities in AI, automation, and data into practical solutions that improve how finance teams work.
- Guide the finance aspects of ERP and financial system implementations, from business requirements to process design.
- Collaborate with Deloitte’s global network of finance and technology specialists.
- Build client relationships, develop new business opportunities, and lead project teams from planning through delivery.
Requirements
Must have:
- CPA qualification.
- Experience as a Controller, Assistant Controller, or in a comparable finance role within a global high-tech company, particularly in software, SaaS, cybersecurity, or digital platforms.
- Strong understanding of finance operations in the technology sector, including financial close and reporting, revenue recognition, controls, and financial systems.
- Hands-on experience driving improvements within finance, such as redesigning processes, implementing financial systems, or introducing automation.
- Ability to engage with senior finance leaders, understand their challenges, and translate business needs into practical solutions.
- Strong interest in technology and the application of AI, data, and automation in finance.
- Ability to lead projects, collaborate across teams, and take ownership of delivery.
- Excellent communication and presentation skills in Hebrew and English.
An advantage:
- Experience with global operations, public companies, IPO preparation or post-acquisition integration.
- Team or project management experience.
At Deloitte, we believe that diversity and inclusion among our people are critical to our success. We therefore foster an organizational culture that embraces and welcomes diversity in all its forms.

דלויט מחפשת מנהל/ת עם ניסיון משמעותי במחלקת כספים של חברת טכנולוגיה, לתפקיד מרכזי בפיתוח פעילות ה־Finance Transformation שלנו במגזר.
התפקיד משלב היכרות עמוקה עם צורכי הכספים בחברות טכנולוגיה, התאמת היכולות והשירותים של הפרקטיקה לצרכים אלו, בניית קשרים עם מנהלי כספים והובלת פרויקטים — מזיהוי הצורך ועד למימוש הפתרון.
הפרקטיקה משלבת מומחיות פיננסית וחשבונאית עם הבנה מעשית בתהליכים, מערכות מידע וטכנולוגיה. אנו מסייעים למחלקות כספים לשפר את אופן הפעולה שלהן ולהתמודד עם צמיחה, פעילות גלובלית ושינוי עסקי.
מה כולל התפקיד
- היכרות עם סל השירותים והיכולות של הפרקטיקה והתאמתם לאתגרים ולסדרי העדיפויות של חברות טכנולוגיה, בשיתוף השותפים והמומחים המקצועיים.
- הובלת שיחות עם סמנכ״לי כספים וחשבים לזיהוי צרכים והזדמנויות, וגיבוש פתרונות ותוכניות עבודה שמתאימים לשלב ההתפתחות ולמורכבות של כל חברה.
- פיתוח קשרי לקוחות והזדמנויות עסקיות, בניית הצעות מקצועיות ומסחריות והשתתפות בתהליכי מכירה יחד עם השותפים.
- הובלת פרויקטים לשיפור תהליכי סגירה ודיווח, איחוד דוחות, מבנה חשבונות, בקרות ומודל ההפעלה של מחלקת הכספים.
- ליווי בחירה והטמעה של מערכות פיננסיות ו־ERP מצד הכספים, כולל הגדרת דרישות, שיפור תהליכים ושילוב אוטומציה, נתונים וכלי AI.
- ניהול צוותי פרויקט ואחריות לאיכות התוצרים, לעמידה בתכולה ובלוחות הזמנים ולקשר השוטף עם הלקוח, בשיתוף מומחים בארץ ובעולם.
Requirements Hebrew
- רישיון רו״ח וניסיון משמעותי כחשב/ת או עוזר/ת חשב בחברת טכנולוגיה — חובה.
- היכרות מעמיקה עם עבודת מחלקת הכספים בחברת טכנולוגיה: סגירה ודיווח, הכרה בהכנסה, בקרות, מערכות פיננסיות ועבודה מול ממשקים עסקיים.
- ניסיון אישי בהובלת שיפור או שינוי במחלקת כספים, כגון קיצור סגירה, שיפור דיווח, הטמעת מערכת או אוטומציה — חובה.
- יכולת לנהל שיח מקצועי עם מנהלי כספים, לזהות צורך ולתרגם אותו לפתרון ולהצעה ברורה.
- יוזמה עסקית, יכולת לבנות קשרים ורצון לקחת חלק בפיתוח פעילות ובהרחבת בסיס הלקוחות.
- אוריינטציה טכנולוגית ויכולת לעבוד עם מומחי מערכות, נתונים ואוטומציה.
- ניסיון בפעילות גלובלית, בחברות ציבוריות או לקראת הנפקה, או בשילוב חברות לאחר רכישה — יתרון.
- ניסיון בניהול צוותים או פרויקטים — יתרון; יכולות תקשורת והצגה מצוינות בעברית ובאנגלית — חובה.
זו הזדמנות לקחת את הניסיון שצברת בתוך חברת טכנולוגיה, להשפיע על מספר חברות ולהשתתף בבניית תחום פעילות בדלויט, לצד שותפים ומומחים בתחומי הכספים והטכנולוגיה.
אנו ב-Deloitte מאמינים כי גיוון והכלה בקרב אנשינו הם מרכיב קריטי בהצלחה שלנו, ולכן מטפחים תרבות ארגונית שמכילה ומאמצת גיוון על כל צורותיו.

jobs.title: ITGC , AI and Risk assurance Consultant
jobs.description:
Description
The Technology Risk Assurance landscape is undergoing a significant transformation. Client and regulatory requirements are becoming increasingly stringent, while AI and automation tools are becoming an integral part of advisory,audit and analysis processes.
At Deloitte, we are expanding our Technology Risk team and looking for Consultants and Senior Consultants to join us and take a leading role in this growing practice.
What does the role involve?

- Working with senior management: Collaborate directly with Risk Managers, CISOs, and CFOs, leveraging Deloitte’s global methodologies and professional standards.

What are we looking for?

Flexible hybrid work from anywhere in Israel
We at Deloitte believe that diversity and inclusion among our people is a critical component of our success, which is why we cultivate an organizational culture that embraces diversity in all its forms.

Requirements Hebrew

jobs.title: Marketing Automation Specialist
jobs.description:
Description
Deloitte Digital is looking for a Marketing Automation Specialist to join our AI & Data team at an exciting stage of expansion.
This is a unique opportunity to play a key role in a growing and evolving practice, work on innovative projects at the intersection of Marketing Automation, Data and AI, and learn from experienced professionals in the field.
We are looking for a creative, tech-savvy team player with at least 1 year of hands-on experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud, a strong interest in customer journeys and marketing automation, and a passion for data and AI.
The role includes:
- Manage and implement Salesforce Marketing Cloud solutions.
- Build and optimize customer journeys using Journey Builder and Automation Studio.
- Manage end-to-end campaigns, from configuration and segmentation to personalization, analysis and optimization.
- Create segments and audiences using SQL queries.
- Work with Data Extensions, Contact Builder, Email Studio and Content Builder.
- Support integrations between Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Salesforce CRM and other data platforms.
- Work closely with our AI & Data team on innovative solutions combining customer data, automation, personalization and AI.
- Handle client-facing responsibilities, including gathering business requirements, leading discovery sessions and presenting demos.
- Work with both local and global teams.
Location: Tel Aviv | Hybrid
We at Deloitte believe that diversity and inclusion among our people is a critical component of our success, which is why we cultivate an organizational culture that embraces diversity in all its forms.
Requirements
- At least 1 year of hands-on experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud.
- Experience with Journey Builder and Automation Studio.
- Good understanding of marketing automation, customer journeys, segmentation and personalization.
- Familiarity with SQL – advantage.
- Familiarity with AMPscript – advantage.
- Basic knowledge of HTML/CSS – advantage.
- Experience and/or ability to work with AI tools and data-driven solutions
- High level of English, written and spoken.
- Strong communication, analytical and problem-solving skills.
Description Hebrew
Deloitte Digital מחפשת מומחה/ית לאוטומציה שיווקית להצטרף לצוות ה-AI & Data שלנו, בתקופה מרגשת של צמיחה והתרחבות.
זוהי הזדמנות ייחודית לקחת חלק משמעותי בפעילות מתפתחת וצומחת, לעבוד על פרויקטים חדשניים המשלבים Marketing Automation, Data ו-AI, וללמוד מאנשי מקצוע מנוסים בתחום.
אנחנו מחפשים שחקן/ית צוות יצירתי/ת ובעל/ת אוריינטציה טכנולוגית, עם לפחות שנה של ניסיון מעשי בעבודה עם Salesforce Marketing Cloud, עניין משמעותי בעולמות של מסעות לקוח ואוטומציה שיווקית, ותשוקה לעולמות הדאטה וה-AI.
התפקיד כולל:
- ניהול והטמעה של פתרונות Salesforce Marketing Cloud.
- בנייה ואופטימיזציה של מסעות לקוח באמצעות Journey Builder ו-Automation Studio.
- ניהול קמפיינים מקצה לקצה, החל מהגדרות וסגמנטציה ועד פרסונליזציה, ניתוח ואופטימיזציה.
- יצירת סגמנטים וקהלי יעד באמצעות שאילתות SQL.
- עבודה עם Data Extensions, Contact Builder, Email Studio ו-Content Builder.
- תמיכה באינטגרציות בין Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Salesforce CRM ופלטפורמות דאטה נוספות.
- עבודה בשיתוף פעולה הדוק עם צוות ה-AI & Data שלנו על פתרונות חדשניים המשלבים דאטה של לקוחות, אוטומציה, פרסונליזציה ו-AI.
- עבודה מול לקוחות, כולל איסוף דרישות עסקיות, הובלת פגישות אפיון (Discovery Sessions) והצגת דמואים.
- עבודה עם צוותים מקומיים וגלובליים.
מיקום: תל אביב | עבודה היברידית
אנו ב-Deloitte מאמינים כי גיוון והכלה בקרב אנשינו הם מרכיב משמעותי בהצלחה שלנו, ולכן אנו מטפחים תרבות ארגונית המעודדת ומקדמת גיוון על כל צורותיו.
Requirements Hebrew
- לפחות שנה של ניסיון מעשי בעבודה עם Salesforce Marketing Cloud.
- ניסיון עם Journey Builder ו-Automation Studio .
- הבנה טובה של עולמות ה-Marketing Automation, מסעות לקוח, סגמנטציה ופרסונליזציה.
- היכרות עם SQL – יתרון.
- היכרות עם AMPscript – יתרון.
- ידע בסיסי ב-HTML/CSS – יתרון.
- ניסיון ו/או יכולת עבודה עם כלי AI ופתרונות מבוססי דאטה.
- אנגלית ברמה גבוהה, בכתב ובעל פה.
- יכולות תקשורת בין-אישית, חשיבה אנליטית ופתרון בעיות ברמה גבוהה.

jobs.title: Partner Administration
jobs.description:
Description
Deloitte, one of the world’s leading professional services firms, is seeking an Partner Administration for its Ra’anana office.
We are looking for a service-oriented candidate with initiative and forward-thinking skills, who takes ownership of tasks, identifies needs, and finds effective solutions. The ideal candidate is proactive, thorough, and hardworking.

Oversee the day-to-day running of the office, including placing procurement orders, coordinating cleaning services, and providing support to employees, visitors, and vendors. The role also includes providing administrative support to managers, such as managing calendars, submitting procurement requests, coordinating international travel, processing expense reimbursements, and organizing partners’ team meetings.

- Very high level of English — required
- Full proficiency in Outlook — required
- Experience working for a global company — strong advantage
- Bachelor’s degree — advantage

At Deloitte, we believe diversity and inclusion are central to our success. We foster an inclusive culture that embraces diversity in all its forms.

Deloitte, מהפירמות המובילות בעולם לשירותי ייעוץ וראיית חשבון, מגייסת תומך/ת אדמיניסטרטיבי/ת לשותפים למשרד ברעננה.

תיאור התפקיד:
ניהול שוטף של המשרד, לרבות ביצוע הזמנות רכש, פיקוח על הניקיון ומתן שירות לעובדי המשרד, לאורחים ולספקים. בנוסף, נדרשת תמיכה אדמיניסטרטיבית למנהלים, הכוללת ניהול יומנים, הקמת דרישות רכש, תיאום נסיעות לחו״ל, טיפול בהחזרי הוצאות וארגון ישיבות צוות של השותפים.
Requirements Hebrew
- ניסיון אדמיניסטרטיבי קודם – חובה
- אנגלית ברמה גבוהה מאוד – חובה
- שליטה מלאה ב-Outlook – חובה
- ניסיון בחברה גלובלית – יתרון משמעותי
- תואר ראשון – יתרון

אנו ב-Deloitte מאמינים שגיוון והכלה בקרב אנשינו הם מרכיבים מרכזיים בהצלחתנו, ולכן מטפחים תרבות ארגונית מכילה המאמצת גיוון על כל צורותיו.

jobs.title: Risk Consultant
jobs.description:
Description
Deloitte, the world's leading professional services firm, is looking for a Risk Consultant.
The position includes consulting in the field of risk management for the leading companies in the Israeli and global economy, and in particular in the financial sector, including banks, credit companies and more.
Consulting in various areas related to risk management, such as:
- Model validation for liquidity and market risk management, credit risk management, evaluation of GenAI-based applications; consulting in risk management of GenAI, gap surveys, process analysis, formulation of leading methodologies, global benchmark, building models and more.
- Broad exposure to the global firm including participation in international work teams and in particular in projects with international companies.
- Exposure to the leading practices in the field of risk management in Israel and around the world and cooperation with content experts in various fields who are the cutting edge of their field.
The position is challenging, unique and includes an affinity to the worlds of economics and finance.
Requirements
- Bachelor's degree from an academic institution in in economics/business administration/accounting - a must
- A master's degree from an academic institution is an advantage
- Ability to draft and write documents at a high level (Hebrew & English)
- Proven analytical skills
- Control of OFFICE applications (WORD, EXCEL, PP)
- Programming experience (Python, R) - an advantage
- Experience and/or ability to work with AI tools – mandatory
- Full command of the Hebrew and English language - reading, writing and speaking
We at Deloitte believe that diversity and inclusion among our people is a critical component of our success and that is why we cultivate an organizational culture that contains and embraces diversity in all its forms.
Description Hebrew
)בעברית ובאנגלית)Deloitte, פירמת השירותים המקצועיים המובילה בעולם, מחפשת יועץ/ת ניהול סיכונים.

ייעוץ בתחומים שונים הקשורים לניהול הסיכונים, כגון:

- חשיפה רחבה לפירמה הגלובלית לרבות השתתפות בצוותי עבודה בינלאומיים ובפרט בפרויקטים עם חברות בינלאומיות.
- חשיפה לפרקטיקות המובילות בתחום ניהול הסיכונים בארץ ובעולם ושיתוף פעולה עם מומחי תוכן בתחומים שונים המהווים את חוד החנית בתחומם.
התפקיד מאתגר, ייחודי וכולל זיקה לעולמות הכלכלה והפיננסים.
Requirements Hebrew

- תואר שני ממוסד אקדמי – יתרון

- יכולות אנליטיות מוכחות
- שליטה ביישומי OFFICE (WORD, EXCEL,PP)
- ניסיון בתכנות (Python, R) – יתרון
- שליטה מלאה בשפה העברית והאנגלית – קריאה, כתיבה ודיבור (יתרון לדוברי אנגלית שפת אם)
- יכולת עבודה תחת לחץ וריבוי משימות גישה פרואקטיבית, חשיבה חדשנית ו-"הגדלת ראש"
אנו בדלויט מאמינים שגיוון והכלה בקרב אנשינו הם מרכיב קריטי בהצלחתנו ולכן אנו מטפחים תרבות ארגונית המכילה ומחבקת גיוון על כל צורותיה.

jobs.title: יריד תעסוקה אוניברסיטת בר אילן 27.5
jobs.description:
Description
Join Deloitte - The World's Leading Consulting and Accounting Firm!
Who Are We?
Deloitte is the world's largest and leading consulting and accounting firm, providing services to approximately 90% of the companies on the Fortune Global 500 list. We offer comprehensive solutions for every business challenge and serve leading business entities across all sectors. Our mission is to make a significant impact on our clients, our people, and the community: To make an impact that matters.
At Deloitte, you'll find over 340,000 employees in more than 150 countries. In Israel, we have around 2,000 employees from various fields such as business administration, computer science, information systems, economics, statistics, and more. We help managers in different organizations tackle their most significant business and technological challenges.
Our headquarters are located in central Tel Aviv, on the upper floors of the Azrieli Towers with a breathtaking view of the entire city. Additionally, we have offices in Haifa, Nazareth, Jerusalem, Beit Shemesh, Rishon LeZion, Ra'anana, and Eilat.
Deloitte Israel operates on a hybrid work model, combining three days of office work and two days of remote work, allowing for a balance between work and personal life.
﻿We are recruiting for various fields, including:
- Audit and Accounting
- Economic Consulting
- Tax
- Risk Management
- Cyber
- Digital Transformation: Implementation, Development, and Architecture
- Analytics and Artificial Intelligence
- Knowledge Management, Learning, and Organizational Development
- Strategic Consulting
- Research and Development and Cloud
- Headquarters and Innovation Roles
- And more
Why Join Us?
- Dynamic and supportive work environment
- Opportunities for professional growth and development
- Work with the most advanced technologies
- An organizational culture that embraces and promotes diversity in all its forms
Requirements
Interested in joining Deloitte and embarking on a journey with us?
Submit your resume, and our recruitment department will be in touch with you.
- All firm positions are open to both men and women.
- At Deloitte, we believe that diversity and inclusion among our people are critical to our success, and we foster an organizational culture that embraces and promotes diversity in all its forms.
Description Hebrew
הצטרפו ל-Deloitte - פירמת הייעוץ וראיית החשבון המובילה בעולם!
מי אנחנו?
Deloitte היא פירמת הייעוץ וראיית החשבון הגדולה והמובילה בעולם, המעניקה שירותים לכ-90% מהחברות ברשימת Fortune Global 500. אנו מספקים פתרונות מקיפים לכל אתגר עסקי ומשרתים גופים עסקיים מובילים בכל ענפי המשק. הייעוד שלנו הוא להשאיר חותם משמעותי על לקוחותינו, על אנשינו ועל הקהילה: To make an impact that matters.
ב-Deloitte תמצאו למעלה מ-340,000 עובדות ועובדים ביותר מ-150 מדינות. בישראל, אנו מונים כ-2,000 עובדות ועובדים ממגוון תחומים כמו מנהל עסקים, מדעי המחשב, מערכות מידע, כלכלה, סטטיסטיקה ועוד. אנו מסייעים למנהלים ומנהלות בארגונים שונים להתמודד עם האתגרים העסקיים והטכנולוגיים המשמעותיים ביותר שלהם.

Description
At Natural Intelligence, we are on a mission to simplify decision-making for millions. We build leading comparison websites that connect high-intent consumers with the world's top brands. Since 2009, we've grown into a bootstrapped, profitable powerhouse in the performance marketing industry.
Now, we’re looking for a Content Marketing Manager to join our Content team and lead a content strategy that combines data, creativity, and experimentation to improve the user experience.
The Day-to-Day
This role demands a proactive, results-driven professional with a unique blend of analytical and creative skills, content and product expertise, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment. If you’re a strategic thinker with a keen eye for detail, a strong sense of ownership, and a proven track record of creating high-quality content that drives impact, we’d love to hear from you!
Your Impact
- ​Create high-impact content: Write compelling, data-driven content, including UX copy, landing pages, and website content, that resonates deeply with users, enhances engagement, and boosts performance.
- ​Maintain high standards: Ensure consistency, accuracy, and alignment with brand guidelines across all content assets.
- ​Define and lead content and product strategy: Develop and execute innovative content and product strategies tailored to business objectives, user needs, and industry opportunities.
- ​Analyze and optimize: Leverage AI, analytics tools and A/B testing to measure performance, extract actionable insights, and refine content for continuous improvement.
- ​Stay ahead of trends: Research industry developments, competitors, and digital marketing trends to identify strengths, and opportunities for optimization, and shape strategies.
- ​Collaborate effectively: Work closely with cross-functional teams, including business development, product, design, and marketing, to align content efforts with broader company goals.
- ​Think big picture: Understand how content impacts the entire user journey and proactively identify opportunities to enhance user experience and business outcomes.
Requirements
- ​Native English speaker — a must
- ​Experienced content manager: 2+ years of experience in content marketing, writing, or editing.
- ​Proactive and detail-oriented: Takes initiative, owns tasks fully, and ensures every detail meets high-quality standards.
- ​Strategic thinker: Combines creativity with a data-driven approach to craft content that delivers measurable results.
- ​​Marketing expertise: Experienced in content, product and UX strategy with familiarity in performance marketing, analytics tools, AI, and A/B testing. 
- ​CMS and AI tools: Skilled in working with CMS platforms and leveraging AI tools to enhance workflows (advantage).
Interested in applying for this position? Along with your CV, please send links or docs (links preferred) to 3 examples of your best work - Include performance metrics demonstrating their impact, such as increased engagement, conversion rates, or other measurable results for each one. Blog posts, landing pages, articles, and marketing copy all do the trick.
Why You’ll Love Working Here
- You won't just hear about AI, you’ll have the best cutting-edge tools at your fingertips to do your best work.
- Our stunning ToHa Tel Aviv offices come with a fully-equipped gym, a music room, amazing coffee, and views for days.
- Come exactly as you are: We're proud to be 52% women, with incredibly vibrant internal communities (Olim, LGBTQ+, Parents, and more).
- Competitive pay and growth paths are key, but it’s the everyday vibe that makes the difference. We love gathering for great happy hours, team offsites, and celebrating our milestones together.
Think you're a natural fit? Join us!
Before you hit apply, take a quick look at the requirements to ensure this role aligns with your experience. We carefully review applications, but due to high volumes, we will only be in touch if there's a strong fit. We appreciate your time!
Natural Intelligence is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We hire based on talent and potential, welcoming applicants from all backgrounds. Reasonable accommodations available upon request at equal.employment@naturalint.com.

jobs.title: Product Manager, AI Security
jobs.description:
Description
About Cyera
Come join the company building the security operating model for the age of AI.
AI has changed how data is used - and security must change with it. Cyera's mission is to empower businesses to accelerate AI Adoption by defining a holistic approach to securing AI - from data to access to model. Instead of perimeter controls and static policies, Cyera provides a unified control plane that understands relationships between data, access, and behaviors across humans, systems, and AI. Backed by the world’s leading investors and working with a large and growing list of Fortune 1000 companies, we are looking for world-class talent to join us as we usher in the new era of data and AI security.
About the Role
Earlier this year, Cyera established an entirely new group with a singular focus: Enabling our customers to safely adopt AI. Not just secure AI use after the fact - but discover it, govern it, and protect it end to end.
You'll join this group as we define what enterprise-grade AI security looks like from scratch. The work spans detection and classification of AI usage across the enterprise, governance frameworks for AI agents and models, and the controls that let security teams move as fast as the technology they're protecting against. The market is moving fast - new models, new attack surfaces, new regulatory pressures, new customer needs - and keeping up isn't optional. You'll need to live at the edge of what's happening, synthesize signal from noise, and turn it into product decisions before others have even framed the question.
This is a rare role: Deeply strategic, deeply technical, and deeply consequential.
﻿What You’ll Do
- You'll own product initiatives across the AI security lifecycle - from how enterprises discover AI sprawl across their environments, to how they govern AI agent behavior, to how they enforce data protection in a world where models are the new attack surface. 
- You'll work across the full spectrum - partnering with world-class R&D teams pushing the boundaries of what's technically possible, engaging CISOs and security architects at Fortune 500 companies globally to understand real-world constraints, and collaborating with GTM to translate customer needs into product direction. The environment is fast, sometimes chaotic, and genuinely exciting - the kind of place where the problem space shifts under your feet and that's a feature, not a bug.
Requirements
Who You Are
Must-Haves
- You have a strong track record in B2B product management - ideally in security, data, or enterprise SaaS - but specific knowledge of any of these domains is less critical than authentic curiosity and a proven track record of building great products in a dynamic environment.
- Exceptional product taste and passion for creating delightful product experiences.
- You understand how large organizations actually operate: The compliance pressures, the procurement cycles, the gap between what security teams want and what they can deploy.
- You have a clear point of view on AI and where enterprise security is headed.
- You're as comfortable in a whiteboard session with an enterprise architect as you are deep in a research paper because something just dropped that changes everything.
- You thrive on ambiguity, move with urgency, and find energy in the pace rather than fighting it.
- You are excited about the opportunity to join a team of high performers in a high pressure environment and take an active role in contributing to the success of Cyera and our customers.
﻿Why Join Us?
At Cyera, we own what we build and how we work. Cyerans are empowered to take initiative, move quickly, and turn ideas into impact.
We push boundaries by challenging the status quo, learning fast, and continuously raising the bar - for ourselves and for the industry.
We elevate together by lifting each other up, celebrating wins as a team, and recognizing that our success is shared.
Feel free to apply even if your experience doesn’t tick every box.
We’re building something special here—and we welcome Cyerans with diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences.

jobs.title: Clinical AI Specialist

Viz.ai is the leader in building and deploying AI-powered Care Pathways and helping doctors do their work. The Viz Platform is deployed in 2,000 hospitals across the United States and trusted by many of the leading life sciences companies. The platform uniquely combines real-time, multimodal clinical data with deep clinician engagement to detect disease earlier, coordinate care teams, and help ensure patients receive the right treatment faster. Viz.ai was the first company to be awarded CMS reimbursement for AI and is ranked the #1 Healthcare AI Platform by hospitals and health systems in the Black Book Research survey. For more information, visit Viz.ai.
We are growing and are looking for a Clinical AI Specialist to join our TLV office.

At Viz.ai, you’ll bridge medicine and technology, helping ensure our AI solutions are accurate, clinically meaningful, and scalable. Working closely with engineers, data scientists, and clinicians, you’ll bring the clinical perspective that shapes how we innovate and deliver care at scale.

- 
Communicate effectively with stakeholders, providing clear status updates and risk assessments.

Track progress and follow up on open assignments to meet deadlines.

-

Educate the greater Viz team on medical and clinical topics
 This opportunity may be for you if you're excited about:

Improving healthcare

Learning new things
- 
Driving innovation in AI
Requirements:
- 
B.A. / M.A. in Brain Sciences, Health/Medical studies

Demonstrable in-depth understanding of human anatomy

Medical research oriented

Attention to details

Ability to prioritize effectively

Curious, proactive, and continuous learner with strong interpersonal and collaborative skills.

Strong technical skills, fast learner

People person, team player

Innovation in the medical domain

Making an impact by working at a company serving more than 1800 hospitals

Training, teaching and knowledge sharing

Working in a startup environment
Location:

יעד התפקיד: מקסום תפוקות המערכת, שיפור הפריון וזמינות המלאי, תוך צמצום העלות התפעולית להזמנה ושיפור רמת השירות.

 תואר במשפטים / כלכלה / מנהל עסקים / הנדסת תעשייה וניהול - חובה. ניסיון של 2–4 שנים (Mid-Level) בעבודה בחברות גדולות בהכנת הצעות מחיר ומענה למכרזים לגופים גדולים בארץ ובחו"ל, ניהול משא ומתן חוזי וממשקי עבודה מול לקוחות וספקים - חובה. ניסיון בעבודה בחברות ביטחוניות – יתרון. אנגלית ברמה גבוהה מאוד בכתיבה ובדיבור - חובה. יחסים בין-אישיים מעולים. יכולת עבודה עצמאית ובצוות בתנאי לחץ. העבודה כוללת נסיעות לחו"ל. המשרה מיועדת לנשים ולגברים כאחד.

jobs.title: רכז /ת רכש בתכנית עמיתים לבוגרים
jobs.description:
מה תעשו בתפקיד? ניהול תהליכי רכש והתקשרויות עם ספקים מקצה לקצה. איתור ובחינת ספקים וניהול משא ומתן. ניהול התקשרויות וחוזים מול ספקים, רשויות מקומיות, מרכזים קהילתיים וגורמים נוספים. מעקב ובקרה אחר פעילות הרכש, לרבות דרישות תשלום וחשבוניות. שיפור והטמעת תהליכי עבודה בתחום הרכש. עבודה שוטפת מול מגוון ממשקים פנים וחוץ ארגוניים.
דרישות:
 מה אנחנו מחפשים? תואר אקדמי באחד מהתחומים: רכש, לוגיסטיקה או ניהול מערכות. ניסיון בתחום הרכש. ניסיון ויכולת בניהול משא ומתן. יכולת פתרון בעיות בזמן אמת. יכולת ניהול תהליכים ועבודה מול ממשקים מרובים. 
 היקף המשרה: 100% בחוזה אישי. מיקום המשרה: מטה החברה בלוד. המשרה מיועדת לנשים ולגברים כאחד.

jobs.title: פלנר.ית במחלקת תפ"י
jobs.description:

מחלקת תפ"י באתר הפיתוח והייצור בירוחם עוסקת בתכנון ופיקוח שרשרת האספקה. התפקיד כולל אחריות על תכנון היצור והאריזה, מו"פ וקדם השקה, הכנת תוכניות עבודה ברזולוציה שנתית, חודשית, שבועית ויומית. פילוס משאבים ותכנון אילוצים. ניהול צווארי בקבוק ועמידה בתוכניות עבודה. קיבולות ועומסים על מכונות יצור ואריזה, הכנת דוח תפוקות, עבודת ממשקים רחבה מול מגוון מחלקות באתר ועוד.

יכולת עבודה בצוות, כושר ריכוז גבוה לצורך ניתוח נתונים, חשיבה אנליטית
נכונות לעבודה בשעות נוספות עפ"י צורך המשרה מיועדת לנשים ולגברים כאחד.

jobs.title: מהנדס/ת תכנון פרויקטלי
jobs.description:

מחפש/ת את האתגר המקצועי הבא שלך?

* עבודה מול ממשקים מגוונים ומתן פתרונות לאתגרים תפעוליים.
הזדמנות להשתלב בתפקיד מאתגר, עם אחריות מקצועית וממשקים מגוונים!
דרישות:

 ניתוח נתונים, בניית מדדי ביצוע ודשבורדים והפקת תובנות עסקיות.
קידום תהליכי דיגיטציה, אוטומציה והטמעת פתרונות AI.
בנייה והטמעה של שגרות ניהול, תהליכי עבודה וסטנדרטים ארגוניים.

jobs.title: דרוש /ה מהנדס /ת ארגון ושיטות לחברה תעשייתית מובילה
jobs.location: יד בנימין, אשדוד, גדרה, יבנה, רחובות
jobs.description:
הובלת פרויקטים לשיפור וייעול תהליכים חוצי ארגון משלב האפיון ועד להטמעה.
ניתוח תהליכים תפעוליים ועסקיים, זיהוי צווארי בקבוק, בזבוזים והזדמנויות להתייעלות.
הובלה והטמעה של מתודולוגיות Lean Management, Continuous Improvement וכלי מצוינות תפעולית.
הובלת אירועי Kaizen ופרויקטי שיפור בהתאם ליעדי הארגון.
אפיון, כתיבה, הטמעה ותחזוקה של תהליכי עבודה, נהלים והוראות עבודה.
ניתוח, תכנון ואופטימיזציה של Layout בקווי ייצור, תחנות עבודה וזרימות חומרים.
עבודה שוטפת מול מערכות ERP, לרבות אפיון תהליכים, הטמעתם ושיפור תהליכים מערכתיים.
בנייה, ניתוח ומעקב אחר מדדי ביצוע (KPIs), הפקת דוחות והצגת המלצות מבוססות נתונים.
ליווי והנחיית מנהלים ועובדים בתהליכי שינוי, הטמעת תהליכי עבודה ושיפור ביצועים.
הובלת ממשקי עבודה מול מחלקות הייצור, ההנדסה, האיכות, הלוגיסטיקה ומערכי המטה.
דרישות:
 תואר ראשון בהנדסת תעשייה וניהול או בתחום רלוונטי - חובה.
ניסיון של לפחות שנתיים בתפקיד ארגון ושיטות, מצוינות תפעולית או שיפור תהליכים בחברה תעשייתית/יצרנית - חובה.
ניסיון בהובלת פרויקטים של Lean, Kaizen, OFEX או מתודולוגיות שיפור מתמיד - יתרון משמעותי.
שליטה גבוהה ב-Excel וניסיון בעבודה עם מערכות ERP - חובה.
יכולת עבודה עצמאית לצד עבודה מרובת ממשקים בסביבה דינמית ומשתנה.
יחסי אנוש מצוינים, יכולת הנעה ללא סמכות, למידה מהירה ותקשורת בין-אישית גבוהה. המשרה מיועדת לנשים ולגברים כאחד.

jobs.title: פלנר /ית RMA
jobs.description:
לדי.אר.אס ראדא טכנולוגיות, חברה ביטחונית מובילה המפתחת ומייצרת מערכות מכם מצילות חיים, דרוש/ה פלנר/ית RMA לצוות ניהול הפרויקטים במחלקת הייצור באתר בבית שאן.

 פתיחה, עדכון וקידום פקעות, כולל בדיקת זמינות חומרים.
 ניהול ומעקב אחר קריאות שירות בהתאם לצורכי הפרויקט.
 הכנת תוכנית קיוטים שבועית ווידוא זמינות החומר הנדרש.
 מעקב אחר התקדמות העבודות בין תחנות הייצור ועמידה ביעדי OTD.
 תכנון ותיאום משאבים משותפים לפרויקטים, כולל תאים ותנורים.
 זיהוי והצפת צווארי בקבוק, עיכובים ופערים בזמן אמת.
 ניהול ועדכון עצי מוצר ותהליכי פירוק והרכבה.
 מעקב יומי ושבועי אחר ביצוע תוכניות העבודה בשיתוף מנהלת התפי.
מדדי הצלחה: עמידה בתוכנית העבודה וביעדי OTD, זמינות חומרים וקידום אפקטיבי של פקעות וקריאות שירות.

* יכולת אנליטית טובה ויכולת לנתח נתונים, לזהות פערים ולהציע דרכי פעולה.
* כישורי תקשורת ויחסי אנוש מצוינים, ויכולת עבודה מול ממשקים רבים.
* היכרות עם מערכות לניהול פרויקטים - יתרון.

jobs.description:
בוגרי תואר או לקראת סיום?
מחפשים משרה שתהפוך את התאוריה של התואר לפרקטיקה בשטח?
יש לנו הזדמנות בשבילכם/ן בעולם הביקורת הפנימית והייעוץ העסקי.
בתפקיד תצללו אל מאחורי הקלעים של חברות מובילות בארץ ובחו"ל, תזהו סיכונים ותהיו גורם משפיע על קבלת החלטות ניהוליות קריטיות.

jobs.title: FP&A Business Partner, Finance
jobs.description:
Medison is addressing one of the pharma industry’s most pressing challenges: enabling access to breakthrough therapies for patients with severe and rare diseases in international markets where traditional commercialization models fall short. As the creator and leader of the global partnership category, Medison has built a first-of-its-kind unified commercialization platform that enables biotechs to effectively plan, optimize and launch their therapies on a global scale. With a strong leadership team and a proven track record, Medison is the partner of choice for innovative biotech companies seeking to expand beyond the US, Western Europe and Japan into regions where most of the world’s population resides. Medison’s affiliate-like model integrates commercial, medical and operational capabilities across diverse geographies, accelerating access and delivering life-changing treatments to more patients, faster. Medison is on a mission to ensure that every patient, regardless of where they live, has the opportunity to benefit from breakthrough therapies. We are looking for a high-impact FP&A Business Partner to join our Corporate FP&A team. This role primarily focuses on financial planning, analysis, business partnering, and driving AI-enabled FP&A transformation, supporting a fast-growing, dynamic organization. The ideal candidate is a strong finance professional and strategic thinker, capable of turning complex data into actionable insights and supporting decision-making at senior levels, with a strong affinity for data, automation, and embedding AI tools into day-to-day FP&A processes, and a hands-on approach and a willingness to dive into the details and get the work done. 
Responsibilities: 
 Business Partnering & Financial Leadership Act as a trusted financial advisor to business units, partnering closely with senior stakeholders to support decision-making Provide clear financial guidance, insights, and recommendations to leadership Collaborate cross-functionally to align financial plans with business goals and KPIs 
 Planning, Forecasting & Analysis Lead the business partner annual budgeting, quarterly estimates, month closing and other forecasting and planning processes Perform variance analysis (Actual vs. Budget vs. Forecast) and deliver actionable insights Build and maintain financial models supporting corporate performance and strategic initiatives Prepare executive-level reporting, presentations, and KPI dashboards Leverage FP&A systems and data tools and emerging AI capabilities (e.g., Anaplan, NetSuite, Priority, BI) to support analysis, ensure data accuracy, and improve reporting processes, with a solid understanding of underlying data flows and systems logic 
 AI-Driven FP&A Excellence Leverage AI, automation, and advanced analytics tools to enhance forecasting, planning, and business insights Drive the adoption and integration of AI tools (e.g., predictive models, copilots, automation solutions) into core FP&A workflows Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, reduce manual work, and streamline processes using AI and automation Partner with data, BI, and technology teams to embed scalable AI-driven solutions into financial processes Ability to leverage technology for automation, insight generation, and storytelling 
 Continuous Improvement & Ad-hoc Initiatives Lead and support cross-company initiatives and ad-hoc analysis Proactively identify and implement process improvements, optimize, and automate financial processes Operate effectively in a fast-paced, fast-growing, changing, and agile environment Ensure compliance with accounting standards and internal policies Drive FP&A process transformation initiatives, with a focus on automation, scalability, and AI enablement 
City: 
Petah Tikva
Requirements: 
 Education and Experience: B.A in Economics, Industrial Engineering, Accounting or Business administration 
This position is open to all candidates.
